simple.meaning: properly, to prick or penetrate ; hence, to blister (as smarting or eating into)

definitions.short: properly, to prick or penetrate ; hence, to blister (as smarting or eating into)
definitions.full: H3554. kavah [ כָּוָה ] verb burn, scorch, brand (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic especially Pa`el; Arabic cauterize ) — Niph`al Imperfect 2masculine singular תִּכָּוֶה Isa 43:2 thou shalt not be scorched (figurative of Israel, || בָּעַר ); 3 feminine plural תִּכָּוֶי֑נָה לֹא וְרַגְלָיו Prov 6:28 shall a man walk on the coals and his feet not be burned ? (|| שָׂרַף of garments 6:27 ).
